brief:
Saudi Arabia has declined a request from Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu to join military operations against the Iran-linked Houthis, according to Middle East Eye. Netanyahu reportedly offered Israeli assistance in combating the group as a means of strengthening ties with the kingdom.

The kingdom did not accept the proposal, marking a rare instance of Saudi resistance to closer military cooperation with Israel on regional security matters.

title: Saudi Arabia rejects Netanyahu request to fight Houthis
